title_working: In This World, The First Word You Say Becomes Your Superpower
world_rule: The first word you ever say becomes your superpower.
logline: The kid with the 'greedy' power secretly took his sister's sickness, and the fastest kid in school runs it off for him.

lines.text: In this world, the first word you ever say becomes your superpower.
lines.say: (confident) In this world, the first word you ever say becomes your superpower.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A girl named Jada began with up, and now she can float.
lines.say: (happy) A girl named Jada began with up, and now she can float.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A boy down the street, Leo, said no, and nothing can ever touch him.
lines.say: (happy) A boy down the street, Leo, said no, and nothing can ever touch him.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: That's why parents spend months whispering words like strong and fly to their babies.
lines.say: (happy) That's why parents spend months whispering words like strong and fly to their babies.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex's first word was fast. He was the fastest kid in school, and he never let anyone forget it.
lines.say: (confident) Rex's first word was fast. He was the fastest kid in school, and he never let anyone forget it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: At lunch, he raced the entire fifth grade and won by a mile.
lines.say: (happy) At lunch, he raced the entire fifth grade and won by a mile.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then there was Marcus.
lines.say: (nervous) Then there was Marcus.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He didn't speak until he was almost three. And when he finally did, his first word was mine.
lines.say: (nervous) He didn't speak until he was almost three. And when he finally did, his first word was mine.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Anything he pointed at and said mine to became his, and only he could give it back.
lines.say: (nervous) Anything he pointed at and said mine to became his, and only he could give it back.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So everyone was scared of him, because nobody knew what he would take first.
lines.say: (nervous) So everyone was scared of him, because nobody knew what he would take first.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: They called him the greediest kid alive.
lines.say: (sad) They called him the greediest kid alive.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Kids joked, Careful, guys, Marcus is coming for your lunch.
lines.say: (happy) Kids joked, Careful, guys, Marcus is coming for your lunch.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But Marcus never took anything.
lines.say: (nervous) But Marcus never took anything.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: His shoes were falling apart. He was always tired. And he had a cough that never went away.
lines.say: (sad) His shoes were falling apart. He was always tired. And he had a cough that never went away.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex couldn't figure it out. One day, he walked right up to him.
lines.say: (nervous) Rex couldn't figure it out. One day, he walked right up to him.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: If you can take anything you want, why don't you just take some new shoes?
lines.say: (surprised) If you can take anything you want, why don't you just take some new shoes?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus looked at him for a second. I already took the only thing I wanted.
lines.say: (soft tone) Marcus looked at him for a second. I already took the only thing I wanted.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then he walked away, coughing. Rex had no idea what that meant.
lines.say: (sad) Then he walked away, coughing. Rex had no idea what that meant.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A few days later, Rex's new running shoes went missing in gym class.
lines.say: (surprised) A few days later, Rex's new running shoes went missing in gym class.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Everyone turned to look at Marcus. Rex was the first to say it.
lines.say: (angry) Everyone turned to look at Marcus. Rex was the first to say it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So you finally took some new shoes. Give them back!
lines.say: (angry) So you finally took some new shoes. Give them back!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus didn't even look up. The principal pulled him out of class, and the whole school talked about it for days.
lines.say: (sad) Marcus didn't even look up. The principal pulled him out of class, and the whole school talked about it for days.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: A week later, the shoes were found in another kid's locker. Nobody said sorry to Marcus, and Marcus never brought it up.
lines.say: (sad) A week later, the shoes were found in another kid's locker. Nobody said sorry to Marcus, and Marcus never brought it up.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But Rex couldn't stop thinking about him.
lines.say: (nervous) But Rex couldn't stop thinking about him.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus's cough was getting worse. Some days he could barely climb the stairs.
lines.say: (sad) Marcus's cough was getting worse. Some days he could barely climb the stairs.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then he started missing school. One day. Then a whole week.
lines.say: (sad) Then he started missing school. One day. Then a whole week.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So what was the one thing he took? And why was he getting sicker?
lines.say: (nervous) So what was the one thing he took? And why was he getting sicker?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: That night, Rex went to Marcus's house to say sorry.
lines.say: (nervous) That night, Rex went to Marcus's house to say sorry.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Through the window, he saw a little girl laughing in bed. Marcus's sister.
lines.say: (happy) Through the window, he saw a little girl laughing in bed. Marcus's sister.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: On her wall hung an old card that said, get well soon.
lines.say: (soft tone) On her wall hung an old card that said, get well soon.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The doctors had given her until winter. Marcus said mine the day she got sick.
lines.say: (sad) The doctors had given her until winter. Marcus said mine the day she got sick.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Now he was the one who coughed.
lines.say: (surprised) Now he was the one who coughed.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex knocked. Marcus, pale and shaking, whispered, Go away.
lines.say: (sad) Rex knocked. Marcus, pale and shaking, whispered, Go away.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex said, Give it to me.
lines.say: (confident) Rex said, Give it to me.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus whispered, You can't outrun it.
lines.say: (sad) Marcus whispered, You can't outrun it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex smiled. Watch me.
lines.say: (confident) Rex smiled. Watch me.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus gave it back. The cough hit Rex, and he ran.
lines.say: (surprised) Marcus gave it back. The cough hit Rex, and he ran.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Faster than he had ever run. The sickness fell behind and faded away.
lines.say: (happy) Faster than he had ever run. The sickness fell behind and faded away.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The greediest kid alive had only taken one thing: his sister's pain.
lines.say: (soft tone) The greediest kid alive had only taken one thing: his sister's pain.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And the fastest kid in school finally had something worth running for.
lines.say: (happy) And the fastest kid in school finally had something worth running for.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then Marcus pointed at Rex and said, with a smile, the word everyone feared: mine.
lines.say: (happy) Then Marcus pointed at Rex and said, with a smile, the word everyone feared: mine.
lines.speaker: narrator
